lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 1 -- Check-In for London

listenings.text: Good evening, and welcome to Sky Air. This is flight two four seven to London. The flight is eleven hours. Please have your passport and your ticket in your hand. One bag on the plane, please. Your seat number is on your ticket. Thank you, and have a good flight.

Hello. This is a message for Bruna Defrain. My name is Lucy, and I am from Sky Air. Your flight to London is on Saturday. It is at nine in the evening. Your seat is fourteen A. Please be at the airport at six. Thank you, and see you on Saturday.

extra_audio.text: Bruna is at the airport in São Paulo. She says good evening to Tom. She gives Tom her passport. Tom says: your seat is 14A. Bruna says thank you.

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: My name is Bruna. I am from Brazil.
lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (affirmative: am / is / are)
